bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without rejection
compound_interest does not validate principal is non-negative
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), accepting invalid loan terms
transfer is not atomic: source balance is debited before destination credit, so a later failure can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, so floats or malformed numeric types can cause runtime failures or inconsistent behavior
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when minimum fee exceeds amount or fee percentage exceeds 100%, with no validation
fx_convert does not validate FX rate is positive/non-zero, allowing negative or zero conversions
